_about: An example of research/directions.json: three directions after the research and the positioning (references/research.md section 9). Invented product, references on .example domains, photo names from research/photos/ledger.json. Check it with: research.py directions check; render it with: research.py directions board
why: Older users read best on a light page with large type, and last month's order sits first.

directions.name: Kitchen table
directions.idea: A light, calm page with last month's order first, like a note on the fridge.

references.name: A grocery subscription app, home
references.takes: the repeat order sits at the top

references.name: A large-print reading app
references.takes: one column, large type, generous space

directions.risks: Can read plain; the photos carry the warmth.

directions.name: Evening call
directions.idea: A dark page for evening use, with one yellow band where help is one tap away.

references.name: A bank app, payment confirm
references.takes: one big confirmation before money moves

references.name: A calm sleep app, evening screen
references.takes: words on one side, picture on the other

directions.risks: Dark pages need careful contrast for older eyes.

directions.name: Clinic card
directions.idea: A tinted, ruled page that reads like a clear prescription card.

references.name: A government health portal
references.takes: closed ruled cells for every fact

directions.risks: A ruled grid can feel clinical; keep the words warm.
